{{Top|leg}}
The '''Hubba bread''' was a type of [[Bread/Legends|bread]] made from [[Hubba gourd/Legends|Hubba gourd]].<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 11">[[Star Wars (1998) 11|''Star Wars'' (1998) 11]]</ref>

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken]] warleader and former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Sharad Hett]] ate hubba bread with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] as he narrated how he came to be among the Tuskens.<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 11" />
